pages.title: AlphaAvatar CLI Output
pages.heading: AlphaAvatar CLI output
pages.lead:
What a terminal of each width shows once the command ends, rendered from its
recording with the escape codes kept as colors (scripts/docs/cli_preview.py). The installer
and Setup ran on 2026-11-23 in an empty home on Alibaba Cloud Linux 3 (glibc 2.32), with the
Linux package CI built for 3e5b8e2d (0.6.8-3e5b8e2d9b2a), its own wheels given with --artifacts,
and fictional credentials; install.sh is the one this change brings, and Setup installed and
validated for real. The panels Setup's grouped install summary and config check's colored
groups change were recorded again on 2026-11-24 with a package built from that change's
source (0.6.8-a6e75ba8fb56-dirty.20261124093551), installed and set up for real: Setup's
(setup-first, setup-bundle, setup-cancel, setup-interrupt, setup-nocolor) the same way, config
check after setup (check) in the clean Ubuntu 24.04 root.
Config, and Doctor declined or with --no-metrics, ran earlier on a clean
Ubuntu 24.04 root with the Linux package of their build. Doctor's measured runs used the offline test doubles of its tests,
marked 离线测试替身: their services and model files are stand-ins and their timings are the
doubles', in rounds of their own. doctor-rounds was recorded on 2026-11-27 from the source at
51e81aeb (0.6.9) and shows Doctor's current layout, its directory as $WORK; the other
measured Doctor panels, doctor-partial among them, are historical: earlier builds recorded
them, and their layout predates it. No panel here holds a real service's figures: those are
recorded apart, in the acceptance log. Every figure ends at the Host's output; LiveKit's
transport, a client's playback and the devices are measured separately. Lines wider than a
panel are diagnostics and commands, which print whole.

pages.title: AlphaAvatar CLI 输出
pages.heading: AlphaAvatar CLI 输出
pages.lead:
各宽度的终端在命令结束时显示的内容，由其录制渲染而成，转义码保留为颜色（scripts/docs/cli_preview.py）。安装程序和 Setup
于 2026-11-23 在 Alibaba Cloud Linux 3（glibc 2.32）上的一个空 home 目录中运行，使用 CI 为 3e5b8e2d
构建的 Linux 包（0.6.8-3e5b8e2d9b2a）、通过 --artifacts 提供的该构建自己的 wheel 以及虚构的凭据；install.sh
是本次改动带来的版本，Setup 真实地完成了安装和验证。本次改动（Setup 的分组安装摘要和 config check
的彩色分组）所影响的面板于 2026-11-24 重新录制，所用的包由该改动的源码构建（0.6.8-a6e75ba8fb56-dirty.20261124093551），经过真实的安装和 setup：Setup
的面板（setup-first、setup-bundle、setup-cancel、setup-interrupt、setup-nocolor）按同样方式录制，setup
之后的 config check（check）在干净的 Ubuntu 24.04 root 中录制。Config，以及拒绝诊断或使用 --no-metrics 的 Doctor，此前在干净的 Ubuntu 24.04
root 上用其所属构建的 Linux 包运行。Doctor 的测量运行使用其测试中的离线测试替身，标为「离线测试替身」：其服务和模型文件都是替身，计时也是替身的计时，来自它们各自单独的轮次。doctor-rounds 于 2026-11-27 由 51e81aeb 的源码（0.6.9）录制，显示 Doctor 当前的布局，录制目录显示为 $WORK；其余测量运行的 Doctor 面板（包括 doctor-partial）属于历史录制：由更早的构建录制，布局早于当前布局。本页没有任何面板含有真实服务的数据：那些数据另行记录在验收日志中。每个数值都止于 Host
的输出；LiveKit 的传输、客户端的播放和设备另行测量。宽于面板的行是诊断信息和命令，它们会完整打印。
